articles.title: Here’s how an Ethereum upgrade helped drain part of Binance’s $6 billion loss
articles.snippet: On Ethereum, the attacker used a 2025 upgrade built to make ordinary wallets smarter, armed with 50 signatures from Binance's own wallet.

articles.title: Will gold’s ‘infinite mint bug’ make Bitcoin more valuable?
articles.snippet: A US fusion startup says it has turned mercury into gold. Could a potential increase in the gold supply strengthen Bitcoin’s claim to be a better form of digital gold?

articles.title: Tampered Ledger reported in Singapore a month before news broke: Asia Express
articles.snippet: Singapore police say tampered Ledgers started showing up there on September 10. South Korean lawmakers look set to delay the crypto tax law for a fourth time.

articles.title: Reddit Stock Plunges 30% as Google's AI Search Hits Traffic and User Growth
articles.snippet: Reddit shares are down 44% this week after CEO Steve Huffman warned that Google's AI-powered search features are cutting referrals, while weaker user growth and disappointing fourth-quarter guidance added to investor concerns.

articles.title: Elon Musk, CZ Trade Blows Over SpaceX Shares After $6.4B Binance Hack
articles.snippet: After Musk appeared to mock Binance’s $6.3 billion hack, CZ reminded him that the exchange’s $500 million bet on his Twitter takeover is now worth over $1 billion in SpaceX shares.
